about.name: Anil Sahith
bio: I build real-world AI/ML systems — and the products around them. I'm comfortable across the whole stack of a problem: training models, wiring up the data and inference pipelines, and shipping the interface people actually touch. Strong CS fundamentals, an eye for detail, and a bias toward things that hold up in production.

I've done my best work at startups, where owning a problem end to end is just the job. Lately I'm building a few ideas of my own too — including a doctor-assistant app that takes the administrative load off clinicians so they can stay focused on patients.
chat: i build things at startups — rn it's ai voice agents 🎙️
offline? pool, gym, some court, or off travelling somewhere ✈️
i also (rarely) sketch faces in pencil ✏️, love to cook 🍳, and watch way too much anime 🍥

experience.title: Software Engineer II
experience.summary: Building an AI voice-bot platform end to end — the real-time speech pipeline, high-performance plugins, and in-house speech & language models.
highlights: Platform & backend services powering the real-time voice pipeline (STT → LLM → TTS), call orchestration, and the plugin API.
High-performance Rust plugins running on the live call path, plus operational tooling.
Building in-house AI models — STT, TTS, and the conversational LLM — via SFT and DPO.
description: SDE-2 on an AI voice-bot platform — building backend and platform services for the real-time speech pipeline (STT → LLM → TTS with noise suppression), call/conversation orchestration, knowledge base, and a plugin API.
Build high-performance Rust plugins that run on the live call path for low-latency processing, plus Rust operational tooling.

Work on in-house speech & language models — STT, TTS, and the conversational LLM — through SFT and DPO data pipelines (mixed reasoning/direct modes), with a scenario-based evaluation framework to catch regressions.

experience.title: Software Engineer, AI
experience.summary: Production ML serving and large-scale document-processing infrastructure.
highlights: Inference gateway on GKE — 10K RPS ingestion, ~0.001% failure across 1M+ docs
NER on ONNX + TensorRT, OCR on vLLM — sub-100ms p99 latency
Distributed extraction with Dask + VLM/LLM models for PII/PHI
description: Built a production-grade data processing system for massive structured & unstructured datasets — distributed parallel execution with Dask and a hybrid extraction engine for PII/PHI detection, integrating VLM and LLM models for image extraction, entity classification, and post-verification.

Designed and deployed an inference gateway on GKE routing NER/OCR payloads across Modal and self-hosted GPU backends, with Redis Streams queue decoupling — ingesting up to 10K RPS while holding controlled downstream throughput (~3K RPS), plus health-aware routing, rate limiting, and retry/DLQ handling for a ~0.001% failure rate across 1M+ documents.

Built high-throughput ML serving infra: optimized NER models with ONNX Runtime + TensorRT and OCR with vLLM + Flash-Attention on GPU node pools, achieving sub-100ms p99 NER batch latency and sub-500ms OCR latency via async micro-batching and A/B-tested concurrency tuning.

experience.title: AI Engineer
experience.summary: Real-time arrhythmia detection on embedded patient monitors.
highlights: Hybrid net (ResNet + CBAM + GRU) on-device — ~300ms latency, <12% CPU
20+ arrhythmia classes with automated ICU alarms
description: Architected a real-time arrhythmia detection system for embedded patient-monitoring devices, with an end-to-end pipeline from sensor integration to frontend visualization and automated alarm generation across 20+ distinct classifications for critical heart abnormalities — reducing clinical response times in ICUs.

Implemented a hybrid neural network (ResNet + CBAM attention + GRU with separable convolutions) tuned for efficient edge deployment — ~300ms inference latency on a patient monitor, processing ECG every 5 seconds at under 12% single-core CPU.

experience.title: Summer Intern, ML
experience.summary: Automated healthcare document processing with CV + deep learning.
highlights: OCR pipeline (PyTesseract + EasyOCR + YOLOv8) — 700+ docs/hr at 95%
Cut document processing time by 90% via multi-threading/processing
description: Automated a document-processing pipeline using computer vision and deep learning to extract and classify data from 700+ documents/hour at 95% accuracy — an end-to-end OCR solution with PyTesseract + EasyOCR for text extraction, OpenCV for preprocessing, and YOLOv8 for region identification.

Accelerated throughput with multi-threading and multi-processing, cutting document processing time by 90% and operational cost, and delivered a production-ready solution integrated with existing enterprise data workflows.

projects.title: CryptAI - AI Trading Engine
description: Autonomous crypto-futures trading system built on a multi-agent architecture — specialized AI agents analyze markets, identify swing/scalp setups, validate risk, and execute real-time trades over WebSockets.
Stores trade history and adapts from performance, with a live dashboard for portfolio and agent-activity monitoring.
Designed for low-latency execution and resilient, observable agent orchestration.

projects.title: StudyArc — AI NEET/JEE Study Planner
description: An AI-powered adaptive study planner for India's NEET & JEE aspirants — it builds a personalized day-by-day calendar around your exam date, runs a diagnostic to surface weak chapters, and rebalances the plan as your performance changes.
Multi-agent adaptivity (monitor → adaptation → remediation) with an SM-2 spaced-repetition review engine, a live readiness score, and a 24/7 AI tutor for doubt-solving.
Full-stack build: Next.js 15 + React 19 with a modern light/dark design system, JWT auth, and a MongoDB-backed API with durable background jobs.

projects.title: Klaro · Mini AI Analyst
description: A full-stack "AI analyst as a service" — upload a CSV and get instant statistical insights, train ML models, and generate predictions through a professional web interface.
Intelligent AutoML (automated model selection, training, and evaluation) plus deep data analysis: distributions, correlation heatmaps, and categorical insights.
Production-ready — JWT auth with role-based access, Docker containerization, API docs, and testing. Built as a full-stack take-home assignment.

projects.title: MediQuick AI
description: An AI-powered healthcare platform focused on simplifying access to care.
Full-stack TypeScript app — a React + Tailwind frontend with a Node / Express backend.
Modern, responsive UI with AI-assisted healthcare features.

projects.title: SEC Filings QA Agent
description: A question-answering system over SEC filings — ask complex financial research questions across companies, sectors, and time periods and get well-sourced answers.
Hybrid retrieval (semantic search + metadata filtering) with automatic ticker / date / filing-type extraction and section-level source attribution.
FastAPI backend with a React + TypeScript frontend and real-time query processing.

projects.title: Secured Health Prediction using FHE-ML
description: Privacy-preserving health risk prediction system using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to enable secure computation on sensitive medical data.
Advanced ML inference pipeline that performs predictions on encrypted health data without ever exposing sensitive patient information.
Comprehensive web interface for secure health metrics input and risk assessment.

projects.title: TodoAI - AI-Powered Task Management Application
description: AI powered Todo app, where you can directly manage your tasks with our AI agent by voice or text, without explicitly performing API calls from frontend.
Multi-agent AI system for task management through natural language conversations.
Two AI modes (Plan and Act) with web search integration via LangChain.
Modern React interface with real-time chat capabilities and FastAPI backend.

projects.title: Custom Stock Trend Predictor
description: Web-based Flask tool for technical analysis with future stock price predictions
Analyzed multiple forecasting models to achieve most accurate predictions
Interactive dashboard displaying predicted curves and numerical stock data

projects.title: Post-Quantum Crypto Simulator
description: Real-time web app demonstrating RSA vs quantum-resistant algorithms (NTRU, Kyber)
Interactive chat with live encryption/decryption and attacker simulation mode
Educational visualizations showcasing post-quantum cryptography concepts

projects.title: HSN RAG + Knowledge Graph
description: An intelligent HSN (Harmonized System Nomenclature) code classification system for the trade industry, combining RAG, knowledge graphs, and NLP.
Hybrid retrieval over vector search + a knowledge graph, with a Streamlit chat UI and a full CLI for batch processing.
Modular, production-ready architecture with a test suite and fast UV-based installs.

projects.title: Warehouse Free-Space CV
description: A computer-vision system that measures and manages warehouse free space from surveillance video.
YOLOv8 detection of racks, pallet slots, and empty spaces, with automated frame extraction and synthetic annotation generation.
Flask backend (REST API + Excel export) and an interactive web frontend for analysis and reporting.

projects.title: NL → Pinecone Query Agent
description: An agent that converts natural-language queries into precise Pinecone-compatible JSON filters for vector search.
Hybrid LLM + rule-based approach with robust date handling, multi-LLM fallback, and comprehensive operator support.
Served via FastAPI and designed for reliable, repeatable query translation.

projects.title: Medical FAQ RAG Chatbot
description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot that answers medical FAQs from a curated knowledge base.
FAISS vector search for fast retrieval + OpenRouter models for natural-language answers, with both Streamlit and CLI interfaces.
Modular pipeline with one-command, cross-platform setup.

projects.title: Homestays Price Prediction
description: End-to-end data analysis and price prediction for homestays using classical machine learning.
EDA, feature engineering, and model comparison to predict nightly prices — implemented start to finish in a Jupyter notebook.
Covers the full workflow from raw data to evaluated predictions.

projects.title: Bank Customer Churn Prediction
description: A deep-learning model that predicts whether a bank customer will churn, from demographic and account features.
Covers preprocessing, model training, and evaluation on tabular customer data.
Built and documented end to end in a Jupyter notebook.

projects.title: Dog Emotion Detection
description: A computer-vision model that predicts a dog's emotion from a photo.
Trains a convolutional neural network with PyTorch and torchvision, then evaluates and iterates to improve it.
An end-to-end image-classification project.
